newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds and Reynolds agrees to buy Crain.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds and Reynolds agrees to buy Crain.

text.p: Reynolds and Reynolds Co said on Tuesday that it had agreed in principle to purchase all shares of Canada's Crain-Drummond Inc for US$44.3 million.
Crain-Drummond, a provider of business document outsourcing and document management, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Uarco Inc, which is itself a subsidiary of Japan's Settsu Corp .
"Crain-Drummond's strength across Canada gives us the opportunity to significantly expand our North American presence," said David Holmes, Reynolds' president and chief executive.
Reynolds and Reynolds is a provider of integrated information management solutions to general business, automotive and healthcare markets.
